facts.label: Comparar antes e agora
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o antes: I lived in London. Use -er than e more para comparar: It was bigger than here. Good vira better.

facts.label: Comparativos
facts.sub: Para comparar duas coisas, adicione -er a adjetivos curtos: short vira shorter, big vira bigger. Depois use than: Your hair is shorter than before. Dobre a última letra em big e hot.

facts.label: Irregulares
facts.sub: Good vira better e bad vira worse. Não diga gooder nem more good. Exemplo: The food was better than here. Esses dois comparativos são muito comuns e devem ser memorizados.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “mais curto do que” e “melhor do que”.
compare.us: Em inglês: shorter than, bigger than, better than. Palavras curtas usam -er; muitas longas usam more.

pages.title: A busy cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday afternoon in a busy cafe in Manchester. Rain hits the big windows. Zoe waits at a table with a cup of tea. A tall man with a beard comes in. It is her old friend Dario. They have not met for years.
“Zoe! Is it really you? You look different!” says Dario. “Dario! Yes, it’s me. Your hair is shorter now.” says Zoe. “Yes, and my beard is longer. How are you?” says Dario.
